parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The order's identifier, as returned by receiveOrder.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit; a retry reuses it, a new user action mints a new one) that makes a retried request safe (ADR 0023, REST guideline section 2). Clients must ALWAYS send a non-empty value of 1-128 printable ASCII characters: with Postgres wired (every deployed runtime) a missing key is answered with 400 `idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one with 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`; a replay with the same key and the same method, path and body returns the original response plus `Idempotency-Replayed: true`, while the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. It is declared optional here only because the in-memory development mode (no `DATABASE_URL`, the mode the Schemathesis contract job boots) has no transactional store and gates the middleware off.
